one_liner: Ahrefs API v3 is a broad REST API with bearer API keys, but it requires an eligible paid plan (Lite and up). Non-paid plans only get limited free test queries. It has an official hosted remote MCP server.
auth_notes: The API needs an API key, which only workspace owners/admins create. OAuth 2.0 exists only through the Ahrefs Connect integration program, which requires applying and going through review. It is not self-serve, so API_KEY is primary. The hosted MCP server also uses OAuth consent or a generated MCP key.
access_notes: The API is available on eligible paid plans. Other plans get only a limited set of free test queries. The pages do not say whether those queries cover arbitrary targets, so the free path is unclear. API units are metered, with a 50-unit minimum per request.
blocker_notes: Meaningful API access needs an eligible paid Ahrefs plan. Free test queries allow limited development. OAuth via Ahrefs Connect requires applying and approval. Ahrefs's MCP terms also forbid using the MCP endpoint through custom scripts or standalone clients.

evidence.quote: Only workspace owners and admins can create and manage API keys.
Users connect their Ahrefs account via OAuth, and your app can fetch data using their API units.
Ahrefs API is available on [eligible paid plans](https://ahrefs.com/pricing). On all other plans, you'll still have access to a [limited set of free test queries]
The reference contains an OpenAPI-compatible specification of each endpoint's request and response format.
Currently, API v3 allows you to pull data from the Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer, SERP Overview, Rank Tracker, Site Audit, Brand Radar, Social Media Management and Content Helper endpoints
Ahrefs provides a hosted MCP server that allows users with a Lite plan or higher to connect their Ahrefs account to supported AI tools.
